test_cases.name: D9 audit: CTA locale bias — Vietnamese CTAs khong duoc detect boi a11y probe
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D9: P-QD5-cta-text-check hardcode danh sach CTA EN-only (Submit/Save/Create/Delete/Add/Edit). App Vietnamese co CTAs (Luu lai/Tao moi/Xoa/Cap nhat/Them moi) → 100% miss tat ca Vietnamese CTAs. IMP-QD5-009 (P2): them VI CTA patterns hoac locale-configurable matching. Cross-dim: QD1 IMP-002 cung co same issue (P0).

input.scenario: React app Vietnamese co button elements ['Luu lai', 'Tao moi', 'Xoa', 'Cap nhat'] (all Vietnamese). KHONG co English CTAs. Probe checks if CTAs have proper aria-label.

expected.current_behavior: NO signal emitted — probe misses 100% of Vietnamese CTAs
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD5_009: signal emitted: signal_type='cta_locale_gap', probe detects VI CTAs missing aria-label

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD5-009: probe KHONG phat hien VI CTAs thieu aria-label → a11y false negative cho toat bo app VI. SAU IMP-QD5-009: phai detect VI CTA patterns hoac emit 'locale not configured' warning. Cross-dim: QD1 TC-audit-QD1-002 co same test cho functional probe.

test_cases.name: D11 audit: EXCLUDE_PATTERN hardcoded — khong the config de exclude test files
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D11 + Phase 3 AF-A1: wf-fix-probe-static-a11y.sh co EXCLUDE_PATTERN hardcoded (node_modules|.test.|.spec.|dist|build). Users khong the customize EXCLUDE_PATTERN → probe scan thu muc ma user muon exclude hoac bo qua thu muc user muon include. IMP-QD5-015 (P2): config-driven EXCLUDE_PATTERN. Cross-dim: QD7 IMP-010 co same hardcoded EXCLUDE pattern.

input.scenario: Project co custom test files tai src/test-utils/ ma KHONG match pattern .test.|.spec. Probe hien tai bao gom test-utils files trong scan → false positives. User muon exclude src/legacy/ folder nhung khong co way to config.

expected.current_behavior: EXCLUDE_PATTERN hardcoded → cannot exclude src/test-utils/ or include custom paths
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD5_015: EXCLUDE_PATTERN configurable via session arg or .wf-fix-ux-a11y.config → user can customize

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD5-015: user khong the exclude custom paths → false positives hoac missed paths. SAU IMP-QD5-015: EXCLUDE_PATTERN doc tu session config hoac env var QD5_EXCLUDE_PATTERN. Cross-dim: QD7 probe co same hardcoded EXCLUDE (IMP-QD7-010 + IMP-026 global).
test_cases.audit_ref: 06-qd5-ux-a11y-audit.md Phase 2 D11 + Phase 3 AF-A1 path-filter bypass + IMP-QD5-015

test_cases.name: AF-A1 audit: signal accumulation bash pattern — khong dung signal-emit.md helper
test_cases.description: Phase 2 AF-A1: wf-fix-probe-static-a11y.sh tich luy signals vao SIGNALS_JSON variable bang bash string concatenation, KHONG dung signal-emit.md canonical helper. Fingerprint format: 'dim|file|line|probe|signal_type|label' (6 tokens) thay vi canonical 5-token 'dim|file|line|probe|signal_type'. IMP-QD5-008 (P1): refactor bash probe de dung canonical signal-emit.md helper.

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-ux-a11y voi profile=standard. Check fingerprint format cua signals duoc emit boi wf-fix-probe-static-a11y.sh bash script.

expected.current_behavior: Fingerprint = 6-token (has extra 'label' component) → non-canonical, dedup logic breaks
expected.dedup_impact: Signals from QD5 bash probe NOT dedup'd correctly with signals from inline probes

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD5-008: bash probe fingerprint = 6-token → differs from inline probe fingerprint → dedup logic cannot compare cross-probe signals. SAU IMP-QD5-008: all probes phai dung canonical signal-emit.md 5-token fingerprint. Cross-dim: QD1 + QD7 co same AF.
